context_requirements: Expression of TBXAS1 and thromboxane A2 synthesis capacity
Presence of thromboxane A2/prostanoid receptor signaling or autocrine thromboxane tone
A cell state in which thromboxane synthase activity contributes to transcriptional output
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Changes in known thromboxane/prostanoid-responsive genes such as TBXA2R, PTGS2, or immediate-early genes
